messages.subject: Assessing Overall Model Significance
parts:
Hello!

How do I go about assessing the overall significance of a model in Unmarked? When I call the model, I get p-values for each level within the model, but I would like to know whether the model is significant overall. When I try to run an Anova, I get the following error:

Anova(fm2)
Error in vcov.default(mod, complete = FALSE) : 
  there is no vcov() method for models of class unmarkedFitColExt

I have also added the model summary below:

Call:
colext(psiformula = ~1, gammaformula = ~1, epsilonformula = ~1, 
    pformula = ~unlist(years.cov) - 1, data = FosnUMF, se = TRUE)

Initial:
 Estimate   SE      z P(>|z|)
   0.0328 1.03 0.0317   0.975

Colonization:
 Estimate   SE      z P(>|z|)
    -1.46 2.71 -0.539    0.59

Extinction:
 Estimate   SE      z P(>|z|)
   -0.197 1.78 -0.111   0.912

Detection:
                      Estimate    SE     z P(>|z|)
unlist(years.cov)2016    -1.76 0.671 -2.63 0.00852
unlist(years.cov)2017    -1.80 0.643 -2.80 0.00515

AIC: 97.34241 

Thank you for your help :)

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Assessing Overall Model Significance
parts:
Hi Sean,

You can't do a F-test but you could do a likelihood ratio test against the null model. See the LRT function. 

Richard

messages.author: 40e173783f466ae0
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Assessing Overall Model Significance
parts:
Yup for a LRT

H0: The effect of all covariates is 0
H1: At least 1 effect is non-zero
